original.statement: The `--registry` CLI flag for specifying a default package registry has been removed; all packages must now use fully qualified names including the registry host name.

decision.reason: [ev-430fc91e4c1d] states "**Removed**: `--registry` flag for default package registry" and requires fully qualified package names, so the subject is the command-line flag `--registry` and the change type is removed, exactly as proposed. Known fact vf-d36855dd939d covers the same flag removal from a code change, but it has no release attached, so I cannot confirm it is the same 2.0.0 change and did not mark this as a duplicate.
